integrations.title: Third-party services
integrations.subtitle: See which external services power the site, whether checks pass, and what to do next — written for non-technical readers.
integrations.howToRead1: Green: checks look good, or the service is optional.
integrations.howToRead2: Amber: worth reviewing — the site may run but something recommended is missing.
integrations.howToRead3: Red: needs attention — usually a failed connection or bad configuration.
integrations.usageSectionBody: This page does not show live bandwidth or database size — each vendor has its own dashboard. Use “Open provider console” on each card to see usage, invoices, and plan limits.
integrations.liveProbeFail: Live probe: failed — check credentials or network.
integrations.liveProbeSkipped: No live connection test for this item.

ok.title: Healthy
ok.hint: No issues detected within the current checks.

warn.title: Review recommended
warn.hint: May work but recommended configuration is incomplete.

error.title: Action needed
error.hint: Connection or configuration error — prioritize fixing.

info.title: Informational / optional
info.hint: May be normal depending on how you deploy.

supabase.name: Supabase (database & auth)
supabase.plain: Stores data, user accounts, and image files. If it fails, the site may not sign users in or save content.

upstash.name: Upstash Redis (API rate limits)
upstash.plain: Limits how often APIs can be called to reduce abuse. Required in production; local dev may use an in-memory fallback.

turnstile.name: Cloudflare Turnstile (CAPTCHA)
turnstile.plain: Helps block bots on sign-in and sign-up. Optional in local dev but recommended when the site is public.

google_oauth.name: Google sign-in
google_oauth.plain: Lets users sign in with Google. If off, email/password can still work if enabled.

hosting.name: Where the site runs (hosting)
hosting.plain: Detects whether this deployment looks like Vercel. Your real hosting setup is in the provider account.

checklog_edge.name: HTTP mutation logging (Checklog)
checklog_edge.plain: Records data-changing requests for operations. Can be turned off via environment variable to reduce noise.

supabase.db_ok: Database responded successfully (test read on a system table).
supabase.db_error: Database returned an error — check Supabase status or permissions.
supabase.db_exception: Could not reach the database — verify URL and service keys on the server.

upstash.required_missing: Production is missing Redis configuration — add it for safe distributed rate limits.
upstash.dev_memory_fallback: Using in-memory limits on dev — fine locally, not for multiple production instances.
upstash.ping_unexpected: Unexpected Redis response — check the Upstash console.
upstash.ping_failed: Could not reach Redis — verify URL, token, and quotas.

turnstile.configured: Site key and secret are set — CAPTCHA can work.
turnstile.not_configured: Turnstile not configured — enable on production to reduce bots.
turnstile.misconfigured: Only one of the two keys is set — both site key and secret are required.

google_oauth.configured: Client ID and secret are set — Google sign-in can work.
google_oauth.email_only: Google OAuth not configured — users rely on email/password if you enable it.

hosting.vercel_detected: Environment suggests this runs on Vercel.
hosting.not_vercel_env: Vercel not detected — may be another host or local; not an error.

checklog_edge.mutation_log_enabled: HTTP mutation logging from the edge is on (default).
checklog_edge.mutation_log_disabled: HTTP mutation logging is off — fewer “HTTP” lines in Checklog.
